summary: EverQuest entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: EverQuest
entries.definitive_edition: Current official EverQuest PC client, with server/ruleset/account state documented

emulation.notes: Use official live client; private/emulated servers are separate preservation routes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official live or progression server, depending on archive target

primary.why: EverQuest is a live MMORPG with decades of expansions, server rulesets, and account states. The current official client is the playable authority, while progression/legacy servers and historical 1999-era states should be logged separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official EverQuest client or Steam install. Record server/ruleset, build/date, expansion access, account/subscription state, character/class/level, mercenary/UI state, group/raid scope, and whether a time-locked progression server was used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting a specific historical-era ruleset.
secondary.why: The live service is current, but progression servers better represent earlier content states.

all_releases.reason: secondary: historical route, no longer a static playable state.

all_releases.fidelity: Free-to-play/live-service route through Daybreak/Darkpaw and Steam.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live, progression, and historical-era server states differ significantly.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record server, ruleset, expansion access, account/subscription state, and character progression.
